body:
Active repair, 2026-10-30 16:33:47 UTC. Current pushed and remote-verified head is **`8f0cea950acb21adafffd90468e2cf98f30c4bdb`**, containing only the qualified resident snapshot harness and its evidence. [Exact-head Native CI 41090142905](https://github.com/0xZKnw/mlxl3/actions/runs/41090142905) is in progress; allocator has already passed. No new global success is claimed.

The snapshot passes in the final main checkout in187.889s (735 checks,3/3 covers). Its pending-guard mutation fails the real production regression and the restored test passes. All319 library obligations and both API instances remain required. [Checkpoint report](https://github.com/0xZKnw/mlxl3/blob/8f0cea950acb21adafffd90468e2cf98f30c4bdb/docs/measurements/kani-ci-repair/resume-snapshot.md).

Other candidates remain isolated. The original wide80 proof passes unchanged locally in13.052s. The three real parser-helper proofs for lengths0/1/2 pass, and rejecting53 is detected by an assertion failure; the full composed parser is now under verification. Grouping and sidecar candidates that exhausted memory are not promoted. No PR61/62 modification, resource-limit increase or remote cancellation.

The following completed verdict table is the retained **4ea54c7b baseline**, not the verdict of the new head:

---

Repair remains incomplete; keep this PR in draft. Final status, 2026-10-30 15:34 UTC.

Remote head verified: `4ea54c7bab6dda58946d1e45e8c891c70963f4d2`, based on `f3f2c1d5e564cacf1b2bf2675bf972c8fc4f3ea6`. Exact-head [Native CI 41073480178](https://github.com/0xZKnw/mlxl3/actions/runs/41073480178) and all eight jobs have completed. The run and the required `kani` aggregate fail. No proof process remains active.

| Group | Final exact-head result |
| --- | --- |
| Allocator | 4/4 library cases pass |
| Speculative | 198/198 pass: all 168 COPY cases, 21 lookup lengths and the formerly crashing tuning proof |
| Core | 72/73 library cases pass, plus both API instances; sidecar collection exhausts CBMC memory |
| Routes | 2/4 pass; the eight-origin and eighty-input grouping cases each time out at 600s |
| Flash | 36/40 pass; three timeouts and one case not reached within the 2700s group budget |
| Native Ubuntu | Passed |
| Native macOS | Failed in an unchanged historical Python guard with `KeyError: 'reaped'`; later MLX steps were skipped |
| EXL3 conversion | Passed, [run41073480191](https://github.com/0xZKnw/mlxl3/actions/runs/41073480191) |
| Desktop regression | Failed at the known `StudioModesCombined.swift:2250` helper precondition, exit133, [run41073480217](https://github.com/0xZKnw/mlxl3/actions/runs/41073480217); outside this diff |

**312/319 required library cases and both API instances pass. Seven library obligations remain unverified.** These are finite model-checking results over the documented domains, not an all-Mac numerical validation.

### Changes and established causes

The old monolithic job stopped on the allocator without a counterexample. Local reproduction explicitly found solver memory exhaustion. The source of the historical runner shutdown signals remains unknown; an OOM in a local reproduction does not establish the cause of those older shutdowns.

The repair inventories every compiled proof, rejects missing obligations and zero-proof selections, saves per-harness verdicts/logs, and fails the aggregate on every incomplete or failed group. Five logical groups use at most four simultaneous proof workers. Limits are 600s per selector, 2700s per group and 6GiB of address space per inherited process, not an aggregate RSS cap. Kani0.68.0 and its action commit are pinned. No error is hidden with continue-on-error.

The original 140 library obligations are preserved through explicit exhaustive partitions, now 319 library cases plus both compiled API instances. Original symbolic value domains, unwinding assertions and meaningful cover goals remain. A private concrete row-validation error keeps the same message and anyhow propagation at its callers. COPY, lookup, prefix, order and cache production implementations are unchanged.

Adding `--verbose` in an earlier version of this PR exposed a Kani0.68 compiler ICE in optional INFO statistics, before CBMC. Remote and local reproductions both produced 197/198 successes and the same ICE. Removing only that reporting option preserves regular per-check logs and all proof checks. The unchanged tuning proof now passes in the complete final CI group.

The fill proof now prepares the same three symbolic 24-entry arrays before constructing Rc/RefCell. Its original boolean domain, name, assertions, real drop/commit and both covers remain. It passes locally and in final CI (116.734s). A pending-clearing mutation fails the existing production unit regression; restoring it passes.

### Remaining proof blockers

All names below remain required. No functional counterexample is established by these failures.

| Required library harness | Final CI evidence |
| --- | --- |
| `hub::verification::flash_sidecar_collection_preserves_present_files_and_size` | `Out of memory`, CBMC status6 after438.372s |
| `flash_support::grouped_route_verification::grouped_expert_routes_cover_eight_symbolic_origins_exactly` | Timeout600.002s |
| `flash_support::grouped_route_verification::grouped_expert_routes_eighty_symbolic_inputs_are_bounded` | Timeout600.002s |
| `flash_support::verification::layer_slot_parser_checks_last_two_utf8_bytes_and_full_shape` | Timeout600.002s |
| `flash_support::verification::resident_slot_snapshot_excludes_pending_and_preserves_lfu` | Timeout600.002s |
| `flash_support::verification::two_routes_preserve_hits_and_never_alias_distinct_experts` | Timeout402.262s when the whole group exhausted2700s |
| `flash_support::verification::wide_cohorts_fit_every_pending_pattern_in_eighty_slots` | Not run before that group budget was exhausted; no verdict |

Unqualified borrowed-map, reserved-vector, stack-buffer and parser prototypes were not promoted. A measured 10GiB sidecar diagnostic still timed out at600s; CI resources were not increased. Further decomposition of these remaining proofs is needed before this can be called repaired.

### Validation and evidence

Local CPU validation: 238 passed / 5 ignored, restored fill regression passed, 34 orchestration tests, strict Clippy, fmt, Ruff and actionlint. Mutations detect COPY-anchor, latest-history, row-offset, allocator and pending-state defects. Every promoted source change has its real Kani attempt recorded; failed experiments remain negative evidence.

The completed run uploaded all five report/log artifacts:
[allocator](https://github.com/0xZKnw/mlxl3/actions/runs/41073480178/artifacts/12985563124),
[core](https://github.com/0xZKnw/mlxl3/actions/runs/41073480178/artifacts/12986269752),
[speculative](https://github.com/0xZKnw/mlxl3/actions/runs/41073480178/artifacts/12986984640),
[routes](https://github.com/0xZKnw/mlxl3/actions/runs/41073480178/artifacts/12987536912),
[Flash](https://github.com/0xZKnw/mlxl3/actions/runs/41073480178/artifacts/12989471351).

[Qualification report](https://github.com/0xZKnw/mlxl3/blob/4ea54c7bab6dda58946d1e45e8c891c70963f4d2/docs/measurements/kani-ci-repair/post-followup.md), [coverage report](https://github.com/0xZKnw/mlxl3/blob/4ea54c7bab6dda58946d1e45e8c891c70963f4d2/docs/measurements/kani-ci-repair/followup.md), [source/validation receipt](https://github.com/0xZKnw/mlxl3/blob/4ea54c7bab6dda58946d1e45e8c891c70963f4d2/docs/measurements/kani-ci-repair/final-code-receipt.json), [raw positive and negative qualification archive](https://github.com/0xZKnw/mlxl3/blob/4ea54c7bab6dda58946d1e45e8c891c70963f4d2/docs/measurements/kani-ci-repair/qualification-evidence.tar.gz), and opti.md preserve the evidence. This description records the final exact-head CI verdicts, superseding the report's then-pending CI status.

PR61/62 branches remain untouched. Their new standard proofs will be inventoried when explicitly integrated; resolve rust.yml by preserving their added native checks and deployment target. PR62's separate guard workflow remains incomplete and does not replace the full inventory; its Desktop fix also needs explicit integration. No merge, deployment, permission change or remote cancellation was attempted. No physical Apple GPU numerical or M1–M5 compatibility claim.
